- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Sync Callout: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen assuring users that logging in restores previously adopted desktop pets. (why: 8 support emails were received regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.)
1: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Layout: Changes the path selection screen layout to two-column to highlight pre-made companions side-by-side with custom creation. (why: Path selection shows a high mean completion time of 514s, suggesting hesitation between custom and template paths.)
2: [adoption, copy] Adoption Guarantee Copy Refresh: Updates headline and body text during pet selection emphasizing instant desktop placement and safety. (why: Adoption drop-off is 63.2% with a long mean duration of 1017s.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Sound Alert: Plays a playful alert sound when generation completes and enables system notifications so users know when their pet drops onto the desktop. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s (median 201s), indicating users tab away and forget to resume onboarding.)

scores.note: Target step conversion is high (84.3%), but support emails validate confusion around pet sync.
Choice step conversion is decent (81.7%), though large mean-median gap indicates hesitation; layout updates require code changes.
Adoption is the largest drop-off step (63.2%), and copy adjustments can be made quickly via config.
Addressing huge mean delay (2336s) with notifications can rescue tabbed-away users, but requires audio and system API integration.
